thread:
maria_sales: Heads up — Acera just sent their security questionnaire (SIG/CAIQ + a few custom questions). They need answers before the POC kickoff next week. Link to doc: https://acera.example.com/sig-questionnaire-2026.pdf

security-bot: Ticket created: SR-4512 (security-review) — assigned to security queue :white_check_mark:

maria_sales: @alex_security can you take point? Sales needs an ETA so we can commit to customer. Main concerns called out: data residency, subprocessor list, TLS+KMS details, and pen test schedule.

alex_security: I'll pick this up. Will do initial triage today and map CAIQ controls. ETA: preliminary responses by EOD tomorrow, full answers in 48h unless blockers.

jordan_se: looping in for CAIQ mapping — I'll run the normal template and flag any non-standard items. Quick Q: Acera indicates "Private deployment (VPC)" in the questionnaire — are they planning Redwood Private now or later in the roadmap? That changes some answers (network isolation, KMS).

maria_sales: They want Dedicated first, then migrate to Private within 2 quarters. For the POC it's Dedicated in us-west-2. I'll confirm exact VPC/network details and share the customer MSA section.

linda_csm: Adding note to the POC onboarding doc: include expected retention and export controls so Support can provision the right logs. Also we'll attach the SOC2 report link to the responses.

alex_security: Plan: 1) run CAIQ template (jordan) 2) draft answers for standard SIG items (encryption, auth, logging) 3) get product/infra sign-off on any control gaps 4) deliver finished package (doc + evidentiary links). If we hit a gap on pen tests or subprocessors we'll propose mitigations for the SOW.

maria_sales: Sounds good. Customer asked about timeline in today's call — I'll tell them preliminary tomorrow, final within 48h. Please ping me if anything looks like a blocker for the POC start.

jordan_se: Started mapping — attached snippet of the mapping checklist I'm using:
```
- CAIQ control: DATA-01 -> Owner: infra-team
- CAIQ control: ENC-02 -> doc: encryption-keys.md
- CAIQ control: SUBPROC-05 -> action: confirm vendor list
```

alex_security: FYI I'm missing the current subprocessors list for Dedicated; infra should have the latest. @maria_sales can you share the vendor list or internal ticket that lists subprocessors?

maria_sales: forwarding vendor list now to this thread and SR-4512. Also adding the customer's security contact.

security-bot: SR-4512 status updated -> In review (alex_security)

alex_security: Quick status — CAIQ mapping ~35% done, two custom questions require legal/product input (data export policy & breach notification SLA). Looping @linda_csm for legal contact and product for breach SLA language.

linda_csm: I'll pull the standard legal-approved breach language and post it to the ticket. Expecting to finish that step today.

maria_sales: thanks all — once complete I'll package the responses and send to Acera. Please update SR-4512 with any attachments so we have an audit trail. :thumbsup:
